messages:
Maya: Hey team, what's everyone doing this weekend? thinking of a farmers market crawl saturday morning, then a board game night saturday night. anyone in?
Owen: Farmers market for sure. I need new herbs. what time?
Maya: Market opens at 9. we could meet at the west entrance around 9:30.
Ravi: Might be late to the market but game night yes. what games are we playing?
Casey: I can bring wings and two games: a quick card game and a longer strategy one. ping me if you prefer coop or competitive.
Maya: Love wings. For games, quick poll: reply with A for coop (pandemic, forbidden island) or B for competitive (catan, root).
Owen: B
Ravi: A
Casey: B
Maya: Looks split. maybe start with coop to warm up then competitive after?
Owen: Works for me. count me in for market and games.
Casey: I can swing both too. bringing extra napkins.
planner-bot: Event created: "Sat: Farmers market + Game night" at 9:30AM, location: West Market Entrance.
Maya: Ok cool. see you all saturday morning. bring cash for the stand that sells chai donuts!
